defects.statement: Unknown keys under a route override would be silently dropped by the config decoder, so a misspelled field such as expected_status would leave the route on fleet-wide policy while the operator believed it had been tuned.
defects.fix: Config loading walks route_canaries.overrides as a nested map (hostnames contain the koanf delimiter, so the flattened key list is ambiguous) and rejects any key not declared on RouteCanaryOverrideConfig, with a nearest-key hint. An override that sets nothing is rejected by validation.

defects.statement: Wrapping a user pattern in an anchoring group by string concatenation can change its structure: an unbalanced pattern such as a)|(b would become \A(?:a)|(b)\z and match any body ending in b.
defects.fix: The pattern is parsed on its own before being wrapped, so an unbalanced group is rejected, and a pattern that parses alone but not when wrapped (an unterminated \Q quote) is rejected as unanchorable.
